items.title: Pay annual electricity statement balance
items.quote: Please pay the balance within 14 days of the statement date.
items.computation: Start of period = statement date 20 Nov 2026 (printed date; a private company bill, so no Bekanntgabefiktion applies, the period runs from the stated date itself). Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the triggering event is not counted, so the 14-day period starts 21 Nov 2026 and runs 14 days, ending 4 Dec 2026 (20 Nov + 14 days = 4 Dec). 20 Nov 2026 is a Friday, so 4 Dec 2026 is also a Friday, a normal working day in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift (§193 BGB) is needed. Due date = 4 Dec 2026.

items.title: New monthly instalment amount takes effect
items.quote: Your new monthly instalment from December is €94.00.
items.computation: The letter only states the month ('from December') without a specific calendar day, so the exact date the new instalment is first collected/due cannot be determined from the text. Assuming the usual first-of-month instalment convention, the earliest plausible date would be 1 December 2026, but this is not stated explicitly, so confidence is low and no firm due date is set.
